Description

The exercise studio at Lifestyle Fitness Kingston is available to hire for fitness classes, exercise sessions, personal training, workshops and group activities. The spacious and versatile studio provides a dedicated environment for instructors, trainers, clubs and community groups to run a variety of sessions.

Whether you're looking to host a regular fitness class, group workout or one-off exercise session, the studio offers a flexible space to suit your needs. Free parking is available at the venue, making it convenient for both organisers and participants.

Book the exercise studio at Lifestyle Fitness Kingston today and get active!
